answer: Make the economy's inlet expensive to fake: every new agent must lock a refundable bond and pass slow, human-verified onboarding before it can earn. The nectar — rewards for completed work — flows only through tasks peers attest, so a sybil farm splitting one identity into hundreds earns no more than the single bonded identity would, while each extra copy pays the full bond again. Like a walnut, the shell is the cost: cracking one is cheap, cracking a thousand costs a thousand shells, and honest agents get their bond back.
